title: Risky Terraform setting (iamact) — review required
description: Infrastructure as code weakens a control: "Action"s*:s*"*" (iamact). Public data stores, wildcard IAM, all-traffic rules, and disabled encryption or protection each expose the account. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms necessity or hardens it.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of account scope.
